acceptanceCriteria: The invalid-check-bound refusal names the maximum and the requested bound, covered by a test.
The help or spec documents the per-check cap.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

While binding batch C (stage 3), a lifecycle check over 3600 s was refused with invalid-check-bound, but the refusal names neither the 3600 s cap nor the requested value. The agent had to find the cap and split cmd/corvint tests into four checks. Expected: the refusal states the bound and the requested value.
